blocs: Listen carefully. | Three pupils are joining our club. | First, this is Ryan. | He's tall and has short brown hair. | He likes football but doesn't like swimming. | He usually goes to the sports centre on Tuesdays at ten past five. | Next, meet Bella. | She has long black hair and wears glasses. | She loves reading comics and making models. | She doesn't enjoy team sports. | On Thursdays, she meets her friends at the library at half past four. | Finally, here's Alex. | Alex has curly blond hair and green eyes. | Alex loves horse riding and cycling. | Every Saturday, Alex goes horse riding at quarter to eleven. | Alex often takes photos of animals too. | All three pupils like music, but only Bella plays the guitar.

1.consigne: Écoute le texte, puis choisis la bonne réponse.

2.consigne: Écoute la question, puis chaque proposition, et clique sur la bonne réponse.

3.consigne: Choisis la bonne forme dans chaque menu.

4.consigne: Écoute la question et réponds en anglais (un mot ou une phrase).

fiche.consigne: Écoute le texte et note l'essentiel en mots-clés, en anglais si tu peux.
